hero.title: See without seeing.
site.meta.home_desc: WifiSenseBox replaces invasive cameras with GDPR-compliant WiFi sensing. Affordable standalone hardware for senior care, smart homes, and business security.
index.demo.title: Camera-level insights. Zero GDPR headaches.
index.demo.description: Replace expensive cameras and motion detectors with a single, affordable sensor. WifiSenseBox delivers advanced presence and activity tracking without capturing images, making it 100% GDPR compliant out of the box.
index.demo.privacy: GDPR-Free Zones: Get the data you need (like a camera) without violating privacy laws.
index.demo.throughWall: No Extra Hardware: WifiSenseBox is incredibly affordable and works standalone. No additional hubs or sensors needed.
index.demo.edge: Through-Wall Sensing: A single cheap unit monitors multiple rooms, drastically reducing your hardware costs.
index.how.title: How WifiSenseBox Works
index.how.step1.title: Plug It In
index.how.step1.desc: Place the ultra-affordable WifiSenseBox in any standard wall outlet. No extra hubs or wiring required.
index.how.step2.title: Skip GDPR Compliance
index.how.step2.desc: Since it doesn't capture images or audio, you can deploy it instantly without complex privacy assessments.
index.how.step3.title: Get Insights
index.how.step3.desc: Monitor presence and activity directly from our web dashboard with just this one cheap device.
